title: Old-school hip-hop
extract: Old-school hip-hop, stylized as old school is the earliest commercially recorded hip-hop music and the original style of the genre. It typically refers to the music created around 1973 to 1983, as well as any hip-hop that does not adhere to contemporary styles.
